'''Son in law of Skywalker AIR ATTACK!!''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Son in law of Skywalker]]
* '''Published:''' 12 January 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Docking Bay|Premiere-L-yavin4dockingbay.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Yavin 4: Docking Bay
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PSE Yavin 4 Docking Bay Skywalker LS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Well I know this is not a very good deck but its all I have because I just started collecting.
